tools.name: baremetrics_get_account
tools.description: Get the Baremetrics account: company name, default currency and creation date. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/account.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_sources
tools.description: List the connected data sources (for example Stripe, Recurly, or Baremetrics-managed data). Each source id scopes the customer, plan, subscription, charge and event tools. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/sources.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_metrics_summary
tools.description: Get all key SaaS metrics (MRR, ARR, ARPU, LTV, churn, new customers and more) per day for a date range. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/metrics.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_metric
tools.description: Get the daily time series of one metric for a date range, with an optional comparison to N days earlier. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/metrics/{metric}.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_metric_customers
tools.description: List the customers that contribute to one metric for a date range (for example who drove MRR changes). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/metrics/{metric}/customers.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_metric_plans
tools.description: Break one metric down by plan for a date range (for example MRR per plan). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/metrics/{metric}/plans.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_cohorts
tools.description: Get cohort analysis (customer retention by signup month). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/metrics/cohorts.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_customers
tools.description: List or search the customers of one source. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/customers.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/customers/{oid}.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_customer_events
tools.description: List the event history of one customer (signups, upgrades, cancellations). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/customers/{oid}/events.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions of one source, optionally for one customer. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/subscriptions.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by id. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/subscriptions/{oid}.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_plans
tools.description: List or search the plans of one source. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/plans.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_plan
tools.description: Get one plan by id. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/plans/{oid}.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_charges
tools.description: List charges of one source, optionally filtered by date range, subscription or customer. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/charges.

tools.name: baremetrics_get_charge
tools.description: Get one charge by id. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/charges/{oid}.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_events
tools.description: List subscription events of one source (new, upgrade, downgrade, cancel and more), optionally by date range. Baremetrics API: GET /v1/{source_id}/events.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_annotations
tools.description: List the chart annotations (notes on metric dates). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/annotations.

tools.name: baremetrics_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the Baremetrics account (use an id from here as user_id for an annotation). Baremetrics API: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: baremetrics_create_annotation
tools.description: Add a note to a metric on one date, shown on the Baremetrics charts (for example 'Price change'). Adds one record; it does not change metrics or customers. Baremetrics API: POST /v1/annotations.
